title: Elfen Lied
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Lucy, a horned mutant 'Diclonius' with invisible telekinetic arms, escapes a research lab in a massacre, is injured, and develops a childlike second personality called Nyu. Student Kouta and his cousin Yuka take her in, unaware of her past or their own buried connection to her, while government squads and other Diclonius hunt her. The story pairs harem romance and comedy with torture, experimentation, abuse and mass killing.
life_message: It holds up love and acceptance as the only answer to cycles of cruelty, while showing how abuse breeds monsters.

Dignity vs honor.evidence: Lucy answers bullying and betrayal with personal vengeance.

Order vs freedom.evidence: Institutions are oppressive; characters seek escape and their own lives.

Civic vs kin.evidence: Kouta's household of strays becomes a family; strangers are threats.

Equality vs hierarchy.evidence: Lab directors abuse rank; the story sides with the powerless.

Tradition vs secular-rational.evidence: Science and genetics frame the world; little religious frame.

Survival vs self-expression.evidence: Fugitives fight to survive, yet longing for acceptance runs through.
